name: BanditRL.OnlineConvex.theorem_2_4
statement: theorem theorem_2_4 (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊥) (hdom : Convex ℝ (effectiveDomain f)) : IsConvexExtended f ↔ ∀ x ∈ effectiveDomain f, ∀ y ∈ effectiveDomain f, ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → θ < 1 → f (θ • x + (1 - θ) • y) ≤ (θ : EReal) * f x + ((1 - θ : ℝ) : EReal) * f y
evidence_permission: historical same-model acceptance is not distinct source certification; fresh review/build gates required
